name: arith_sum_natAbs_moebius
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d).natAbs = 2 ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors n
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n), ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d).natAbs = 2 ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors n
informal: Σ_{d|n} |μ(d)| = 2^ω(n) — |μ(d)| is the indicator of squarefree d; squarefree divisors of n biject with subsets of n.primeFactors.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d).natAbs = 2 ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors n
